from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A paper from the provided collection, including its title and its citation links to other papers in the collection."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of this paper as it appears in the document")
    citations: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers in the collection that this paper explicitly cites")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates the parsed papers from the collection to enable citation chain construction."""
    papers: list[Paper]
